about_the_game:
Enter the battlefield of Dfiance — a free-to-play tactical card game where cunning strategy, timing, and sharp decision-making determine your path to victory. Designed for players who crave fast-paced, competitive card duels with a twist, Dfiance brings you into a fantasy world where every match is a mind game. Build your army, craft your deck, and lead your forces into battle.

A FAIR GAME FOR TRUE COMPETITORS
Dfiance is free to play and always will be. With no pay-to-win mechanics, progress comes from your skill and smart deck-building. Win cards, unlock new tactics, and rise through the ranks based on merit alone.

VISUALLY DISTINCT, STRATEGICALLY DEEP
Every unit, spell, and battlefield is brought to life with unique animations and effects. Whether you’re spectating or clashing head-on, the world of Dfiance keeps you immersed with each move.

WIN WITH BRAINS, NOT LUCK
Victory in Dfiance isn’t random. Outsmart your opponents in a duel of wits across a dynamic battlefield. Control the tempo, predict your rival’s moves, and dominate with your strategy — not your wallet.

MULTIPLE MODES. ONE GOAL: DOMINATE
From ranked PvP battles and weekend tournaments to themed challenges and custom lobbies, there’s always a new way to test your deck and prove your dominance. With our new Spectate Mode, you can even watch the top players live and learn from their every move.

FIGHT ACROSS THE FRONTLINES
Engage your cards across unique lanes — manage the formation, time your combos, and deploy key units when the moment is right. With every decision carrying weight, no battle feels the same.

YOU SET THE STRATEGY. YOU LEAD THE CHARGE.
Will you pressure early or play the long game?

Only the best tacticians rise.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11, DX12 capable
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
